driver_archetypes.rationale: Standard compliant car behavior to match M1/car discharge headway (observed 0.3351s) and ensure correct lane positioning.
Higher impatience and larger gaps allow occasional early starts (M2/early/car target 0.0074) without excessive red-running.
Very low tau and tight lateral gaps (M1/moto target 0.2463s) with right alignment to reduce overshoot depth.
High tau and center alignment mimic slow riders who overshoot the stop line (M4/overshoot_share target 0.6327).
Custom1 base class enables queue_space_seeking to ride in lane 0 (wrong lane) to bypass queues (M8/moto wrong-lane share target 0.2131).
High tau/minGap and long red-drive time ensure illegal left-turners wait in the box until opposing green ends (M6/approach/l/moto ~64s).

traci_rules.rationale: Target M2/early/car (0.0074); higher probability and creep speed to match observed early-start share.
Target M2/early/moto (0.1303); higher probability for motorcycles to creep before green.
Target M3/share/moto (0.09048) and M3/var_to_mean; higher p0 and k simulate the 'swarm' effect where motorcycles run red in groups.
Target M8/moto wrong-lane share (0.2131); trigger draw at shorter queue length to increase frequency of lane-0 usage.
Target M7a/release_time (0.28s) and M6/junction/illegal_l/moto; slightly longer release lag accounts for box geometry and ensures exit shortly after opposing green ends.
Target M4/lat_moto (7.1m); lat_offset 0 keeps the slow motorcycle in the lane center to minimize overshoot.
Target M9b/delay_blocked and M7c/slope; very high probability reflects that motorcycles frequently squeeze past standing U-turners.
